subject: science
title: Unit 2: Sound & Musical Instruments
subTitle: Stringed & Wind instruments, Pitch and Tuning

cards.vietnamese: Nhạc cụ dây (đàn ghita, vĩ cầm, đàn tranh...)
cards.definition: Musical instruments that produce sound from vibrating strings.
cards.example: Violin and guitar are stringed instruments.

cards.vietnamese: Nhạc cụ hơi/thổi (sáo, kèn trumpet, kèn clarinet...)
cards.definition: Musical instruments that contain a resonator in which a column of air is set into vibration by the player blowing.
cards.example: Flutes and trumpets are wind instruments.

cards.vietnamese: Vặn chặt, làm căng dây (làm tăng cao độ/pitch)
cards.definition: To make a string or screw firmer or more secure.
cards.example: Tightening a guitar string makes the sound higher in pitch.

cards.vietnamese: Chùng, lỏng (dây chùng tạo âm trầm hơn/lower pitch)
cards.definition: Not fitting tightly or not firmly attached.
cards.example: A loose guitar string produces a lower pitch.

cards.vietnamese: Chỉnh âm, lên dây đàn cho đúng nốt
cards.definition: To adjust a musical instrument to the correct pitch.
cards.example: Musicians tune their instruments before a concert.

exercises.question: Which of these is a STRINGED instrument?
exercises.explanation: Guitar và Violin tạo ra âm thanh từ dây rung (stringed instruments).

exercises.question: What happens to the pitch when you TIGHTEN a guitar string?
exercises.explanation: Khi kéo căng dây đàn (tighten), dây rung nhanh hơn làm âm thanh cao hơn (higher pitch).

exercises.question: Which of these is a WIND instrument (nhạc cụ hơi)?
exercises.explanation: Flute (cây sáo) là nhạc cụ hơi được thổi bằng cột không khí (wind instrument).
